Commentary.Commentary: Right then. This wraps up the T20I series. The two teams will go head-to-head in a 3 match ODI series. The first one kicks off on 20th July at 1830 GMT. But as you all know, we will be early for the build-up. Till then cheers and goodbye!
So, West Indies win the game by 16 runs and they seal the series 4-1. Nicholas Pooran waits for his players to join him. He lifts the trophy and the celebrations have started in St. Lucia.

Nicholas Pooran, the winning skipper is up for a chat. He says it's a wonderful achievement for the team. Also adds that it feels even better after we had lost the last series. Also praises the addition of Hayden Walsh to the team and is an important asset to the side. Adds that captaincy is tough but Pollard made it easier for him. Ends by saying he can't single out anyone who has been outstanding, as it's the whole team that performed.

Hayden Walsh, Player of the series. Says that he is happy to be back in the Windies colors Says that he was patient and he grabbed his opportunity as it came. Says that we are happy to win 4-1. Informs that they were a bit low during the South Africa series but the camaraderie was good in the dressing room.

Aaron Finch is up for a chat. He says Marsh has been a stand-out player for us in this series. He has sealed the number three spot. Goes onto say, they always failed to back it with their batting. Also says they executed a little bit better into the last play as they picked up four wicket in the final stage. Also praises Evin Lewis for his knock. Ends by saying, plenty of positive things to take from the game.

Evin Lewis, Player of the match. Says that it is always good to score runs and help the team to victory. Says that he is working hard since 2017. Says that this is his first series against Australia and he is happy to win. Says that we are confident to go against Pakistan next.
... Time for Presentation..

What can we say about West Indies and their effort in the field. They are just brilliant and top-notch. Be it the keeper, having a shy at the stumps or a spinner taking a one-handed diving catch in the deep, they have it all. It's a full package with talented and athletic individuals. If Russell does not perform with the bat, that's not a problem. He shows up with the ball and does the trick. The pacey pair of Sheldon Cottrell and Andre Russell each picked up three wickets. Hayden Walsh also bagged a wicket. There were two run-outs that took place. Chris Gayle and Fabian Allen probed good lines and lengths but were not able to get onto the wicket column. Oshane Thomas was expensive of the lot. But other than that it was a brilliant outing from the host.

Haven't we already seen this in the series? The Aussies continue to struggle in the middle overs. And yet again they witness a collapse. Josh Philippe was sent back early on a duck. Aaron Finch and Mitchell Marsh were sent back in their 30's. The Aussies failed to maintain a partnership in the middle. Moises Henriques got out to an unnecessary runout. Later, they kept losing wickets in regular intervals. They kept falling like a pack of cards, which was not how they envisioned to end the series with.

The hosts dominated with the ball and in the field. They did not give any breather to the Aussies. They failed to chase down the target of 200 runs. As, West Indies win the series 4 to 1, very convincing and commanding.
Short ball on middle. Mitchell Swepson pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. WEST INDIES WIN BY 16 RUNS AND WIN THE T20I SERIES 4-1.
On middle. Josh Hazlewood sweeps it to mid-wicket for a single.
Around off, flatter ball. Josh Hazlewood blocks it out on the off side.
SIX In the arc, and out of the park! Josh Hazlewood hits this sweetly over long on fence for a clean six. Pitched up just outside off and he pounces on it.
FOUR! Overpitched outside off stump and Josh Hazlewood lofts it through deep extra cover for a boundary.
Tossed up on off, Josh Hazlewood slogs sweeps this one towards mid-wicket for a couple. It was not timed well, it went high in the air, but fell safe wide of the deep sqaure leg fielder.
Another good length ball outside off. Mitchell Swepson throws the kitchen sink at it but fails to connect any bat on it. End of a brilliant spell from Sheldon Cottrell.
A length ball outside off. Mitchell Swepson swings and misses.
The last man to walk in is Josh Hazlewood.

OUT! RUN OUT! A good piece of fielder there! Zampa was in but his bat was hanging in the air. On middle. Swepson works it to deep covers. They complete a single and run across for another one. Hayden Walsh in the deep fires in to the bowler's hand. Cottrell does rest of the job and Windies are nearly there.
Umpire review for run out. The replays roll in and confirm the bails are off as the bat is hanging in the air.
Length ball on middle. Mitchell Swepson smacks it straight back to the bowler.
WIDE! Fuller and outside off. Left alone. Wided.
WIDE! Sprays it way down the leg side. Wided.
Adam Zampa comes in at number 10.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sheldon Cottrell gets his third wicket of the night! Full ball, outside off. Jason Behrendorff lofts it towards long off, does not middle it. Hits it straight to Fabian Allen who takes a simple catch. He is everwhere on the pitch today.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball wide outside off. Jason Behrendorff swings and misses.
SIX! Smoked! A full ball on off. Mitchell Swepson smashes it over long off for a biggie. 35 needed off 12 balls.
Swepson makes room for himself. Hayden Walsh follows him with a quicker delivery. Swepson lobs it out on the leg side.
On off, the ball rolls to square leg of the inside edge. The batters take a single.
On middle. Mitchell Swepson comes down the track and pushes it to covers for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked to mid-wicket.
A short ball on middle. Swepson rocks back and tucks it to the leg side for a brace.
Hayden Walsh comes back into the attack.
Outside off, Jason Behrendorff looks to chase it but misses.
On off, Jason Behrendorff lifts it towards long on. The fielder in the deep collects it in time. The batters take a couple.
Umpire review! There is a review for run out at the bowler's end. The replays roll in and shows the batter was well inside the crease. Not out is the final decision.

It was a full and wide ball outside off stump. Jason Behrendorff drives it to long off for a couple of runs.  The non striker has just made it to his end. The decision was sent upstairs, but the non striker has made it in the end.
This time he gets it right. Full and wide outside off, Jason Behrendorff misses the ball as it was out of his reach.
WIDE! Almost a replay of the previous delivery. Full and outside off. Jason Behrendorff leaves it alone. Wide called.
WIDE! Goes for wide outside off, but it is way outside off. Jason Behrendorff looks to chase but misses. Umpire signals it as a wide.
Who will come out at number 9? It is going to be Jason Behrendorff.

OUT! CAUGHT by Nicholas Pooran! This looks game for the Windies as another one bites the dust! The salute is out as Sheldon Cottrell celebrates his second wicket! A short ball on middle. Tye miscues his pull,  gets a top edge. In the air and just around short fine leg where Nicholas Pooran runs across and takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball around off stump, cut towards point for a run by Mitchell Swepson
SIX! This match has not finished yet! A short ball on middle. Tye stands tall and pulls it over square leg for a biggie.
FOUR! The safest place to hit a boundary! A full toss on middle. Tye smashes it over the bowler's head straight down the ground for four.
Length ball, outside off. Swepson dabs it to third man for one.
Who will walk in at number 8? It is going to be Mitchell Swepson.

OUT! Cleaned him up! Inside edge and Wade has to walk back. It was a wide ball on a good length, Wade tries to muscle it over mid-wicket, but only gets an inside edge and it cleans him up as the ball drags on the stumps. Australia in real trouble now.
SIX! That is a huge hit!. A full ball outside off. Matthew Wade moves across in the crease, and smacks towards square leg for a maximum.
Good length ball around off, Andrew Tye turns it to long on for a run.

Three dots in a trot! This is brilliant from Chris Gayle. He delivered when his team needed him. Tossed up, down the leg. Wade follows the line of the delivery and looks to flick it away but misses. He gets rapped on the pads. Wade doesn't look happy.
Two dots in a row. Loopy ball, full and on middle. Wade looks to work it on the leg side but does not get the connection he intended to. The ball takes the inside edge and stays low.
Tossed up, on off, Wade looks to flick it away but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Floated full and on off, Tye drills  it to long on for a single.
Full and on off, Wade works it to mid on for a single.
LEG BYE! Loopy ball, on middle. Tye looks to flick it but misses and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls out. The batters sneak a leg bye.
A length ball, on off. Tye works it towards fine leg for a single.
A full length delivery, on middle and leg. Tye gets an inside edge onto the pads, as the ball rolls towards fine leg. Hayden Walsh recovers the ball in time. The batters take a couple.
Full and outside off, Wade pushes it to cover for a single.
FOUR! Nicely hit. A full length ball, on off. Wade stays back and smokes it through the long on region for a boundary.
Andrew Tye is the next man in.
Outside off, Wade looks to chase it but misses.

OUT! CAUGHT! Australia falling apart again, we have seen this so often in this series. A full length ball, on off. Carey looks to go big but miscues it completely. The ball hits the toe end of the bat and goes high up in the air. It goes towards long off. Lendl Simmons gets under it and takes an easy catch. Half of the Australian side is sent back to the shed.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Andre Russell

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller on middle. Carey pushes it to long on for a single.
On middle. Carey goes for the reverse sweep, does not middle it, hits it towards point for a single.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
Another fuller ball, quicker this time, around leg. Carey mistimes his paddle sweep.
Flatter ball angling on middle and leg. Wade flicks it to square leg for one run.
Full ball on leg pole. Carey works it to long on for a single.
A length ball outside off. Wade rocks back and cuts it to point. 84 required off 48 balls.
FOUR! Up and over! A full ball outside off. Wade lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
On middle, on a length. Carey nudges it to mid-wicket for one run.
A slower full ball, just around off. Carey looks to push but gets deceived by the pace of the ball.
Full ball, on off. This is pushed to covers for one.
FOUR! Innovative! A full ball way outside off. Wade moves to the off side and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary.
A tidy over to finish from Chris Gayle! Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, eased down to long off for one.
On middle. Carey goes for the paddle sweep but manages a bottom edge back on the pitch.
Flatter ball on middle. Carey works it to the leg side.
Another full ball on middle. Wade mistimes his push to long on for one.
Full ball way outside off. Driven to deep covers for a single.
Chris Gayle comes into the attack now.
Full on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Flatter ball outside off. Matthew Wade cuts it past point for a couple of runs. He is off the mark.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Matthew Wade.

OUT! RUN OUT! The skipper, Pooran is quick to react. He gets his man running in from the non-striker's end. Moises Henriques knew he was gone. This is going from to worse for Australia. This is the second wicket of the over. A tossed up ball, on off. Carey nudges it to the leg side and takes off for a single. Pooran though chases after it, he is fast enough to remove his gloves on his way. He collects the ball, rotates and hits the stumps on the striker's end, where Moises Henriques was running in. The West Indies camp is delighted. The umpire takes it upstairs to have a closer look. The replays roll in and show that the batter was short of the crease.
Umpire review! The umpire takes it upstairs for confirming the run out. The replays roll in and shows the batsman was short of the crease. The decision is OUT.

FOUR! Boundaries still coming though. Alex Carey gets off the mark with a boundary. Tossed up, and down the leg, Carey works it fine and the ball races away to the boundary. Also brings up the 100 for Australia.
WIDE! Tossed up, down the leg side. Carey looks to sweep it but misses.
Who will walk out at number 5? It is going to be Alex Carey.

OUT! That is a brilliant diving catch at long on from Fabian Allen This man keeps on impressing in the outfield and lives up to his reputation. It was a full toss on leg stump and Aaron Finch tries to slog it over long on  but mistimes it and Fabian Allen did what he does best. Runs to his left and completes one handed diving catch. West Indies continue to remain top-notch in their fielding.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball outside off, Aaron Finch cuts it towards point for a couple of runs. He is limping though.
Flatter and outside off. Dabbed to backward point for a single.
Full and outside off. Pushed to long off for one.
Brilliant fielding by Hayden Walsh! A short ball outside off. Moises Henriques cuts it to point where Hayden Walsh leaps up and grabs it on a bounce.
On middle, Finch comes down the track and flicks it to square leg for a single.
BEATEN! A flatter ball outside off. Finch looks to cut but misses it completely.
Around off, pushed to long off for a single.
Fabian Allen comes back into the attack. His figures 2-0-25-0 so far. He replaces Oshane Thomas.
Short of a length ball, Moises Henriques punches it to long on for a run.
FOUR! Overpitched ball outside off and Moises Henriques dispatches it through extra cover for a boundary.
On off, pushed to covers for another single.
On off, Moises Henriques works it to the leg side for a single.
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side. Henriques leaves it alone. Wide called.
LEG BYE! Aaron Finch goes down on one knee, misses the sweep as the ball rolls on to the left of the keeper, they sneak in a single.
Pitched short just around off stump, punched towards cover for a run.

FOUR! This over turned out to the expensive. Not looking good for Oshane Thomas. A full length delivery, outside off. The bat takes the outside edge and goes past the keeper towards the boundary at third man.

FOUR! Nicely played. A full toss, above the waist height. Finch goes back and guides it over the slip region for a boundary at third man. Aaron Finch was looking for a no ball here, but the umpire doesn't give it. He is frustrated.
Full and outside off. Finch drives it to cover.

FOUR! Streaky! A full length ball, outside off. Aaron Finch stays back and looks to push it to the off side. The ball though take the outside edge and flies past Nicholas Pooran behind the wickets. The ball races away to the boundary at third man. The bowler has his hand on his head.
Back of a length ball, outside off. Finch looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, on off. Moises Henriques pushes it to cover for a single.
Change of ends for Oshane Thomas. He replaces Andre Russell. His figures 1-0-15-0 so far.
Flatter and way outside off. Finch swings and misses. End of the Powerplay, Australia are 65 for 2.
FOUR! Good shot! Flatter ball outside off. Finch stands tall and punches it through covers for another boundary.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Good shot! Another full ball, on middle. Moises Henriques paddle sweeps it to fine leg fence for four.
Half an appeal here for LBW turned down! A full ball around middle and leg. Moises Henriques looks to sweep it but fails to connect any bat on it.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle. Moises Henriques comes dancing down the track and goes inside out this time towards deep extra cover for a boundary.
FOUR! Pulled away! A short of a length ball, around middle and leg. Finch helps it away past the diving keeper to fine leg for a boundary.
Brilliant delivery! A yorker on middle. Finch digs it out in time. That was going straight on the middle stump.
Another fuller ball on middle. Moises Henriques tucks it to long on for a single.
On middle. Finch works it to long on for another one.
Full on middle. Moises Henriques works it down to long on for a single. He is off the mark straightaway.
Who will come out next? It is going to be Moises Henriques.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! This is a huge wicket for West Indies. Andre Russell strikes on his first delivery. The dangerous Marsh goes back to the hut for a quick 30! A good length ball on middle. Marsh looks to go straight down the ground but hits it back to Andre Russell who takes a brilliant catch on his follow-through. Two wickets down now the Aussies.
Andre Russell comes into the attack. He replaces Sheldon Cottrell.
Full on middle. Finch pushes it wide of long on for a brace.
FOUR! Cracked! A short ball outside off. Finch rocks back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single
Around off. Marsh goes for the paddle sweep but misses.
FOUR! Well played! Tossed up ball outside off. Marsh slaps it through covers-point for four
Flatter ball outside off. Finch pushes it to covers.
Fabian Allen comes into the attack now.
A length ball outside off. Marsh works it on the off side. 10 runs coming of this over.
FOUR! Magnificent shot! Just sublime to watch it! Touch fuller outside off. Marsh drives it through mid off for a boundary.
A length ball outside off. Marsh taps it to backward point.
Around off, pushed to covers.
FOUR! Moves to 21 in no time! A short ball on middle. Marsh pulls it to square leg for a boundary.
A length ball, on off. Marsh pushes it through covers for a brace.
A touch short, outside off. Finch pushes it to cover.
A length ball, on off, Marsh pushes it to third man for a single.

FOUR! Slapped! Mitchell Marsh is showing his versitility here, as he smacks this one on the off side. On a length, outside off. Marsh stays back and punches it through the cover region for a boundary. This also means that he has now scored 200 runs in this series.
FOUR! Nicely played! A full length ball, on the pads. Marsh flicks it through mid-wicket into the gap. The ball goes into the boundary on a bounce. Moves to 10 from 2 balls.
SIX! It takes no time for Marsh to get off the mark. A short ball, on off. Marsh stays back and pulls it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
A length ball, on off. Marsh defends it out.

OUT! CAUGHT! West Indies get their first breakthrough and Josh Philippe is back in the hut without troubling the score! The extra ball works it for Sheldon Cottrell! A short ball, on middle. Philippe looks to pull but is too late to his stroke. Gets a top edge, high in the air and towards mid-wicket where Lendl Simmons takes a simple catch. Sheldon Cottrell celebrates with his iconic salute.
Commentary.Howout: c Lendl Simmons b Sheldon Cottrell

Commentary.Commentary: FIVE WIDES! That was rising up! A pacy short ball on middle, rises off the deck. Josh Philippe misses his pull. Pooran behind the stick stretches but the ball goes over him for four.
Who will come out at number three? It is going to be Mitchell Marsh. Also, Oshane Thomas to bowl from the other end.
WIDE! Another wide delivery! A full ball way down the leg side. Wide given.
Around off, pushed to mid off.
A full ball, Angling in, on middle. Finch tucks it to square leg for a single. Aaron Finch is underway.
WIDE! Spills it way down the leg side. Left alone. Wide given.
A length ball on middle. Finch gets inner half of the bat as he looks to defend towards mid-wicket.
LEG BYE! A full ball, around leg. Philippe looks to flick but misses. Gets hit on the pads and takes a leg bye as it goes to fine leg. Australia are off the mark.
Cotrell starts with a full ball on middle. Josh Philippe nudges it to mid-wicket.
